**Joe’s Pizzeria in Tirol**

Discover authentic Italian flavors in the heart of the Alps! At **Joe’s Pizzeria in Tirol**, we bring the taste of Naples to the stunning landscapes of **Tirol**. Whether you're craving a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Diavola**, or a crispy **Prosciutto e Funghi**, our handmade pizzas are baked to perfection in a traditional wood-fired oven.

Pair your meal with a refreshing **Aperol Spritz**, a crisp **Radler**, or one of our locally sourced **Tiroler Bier** selections. After dinner, indulge in a slice of **Kaiserschmarrn** or a scoop of creamy **Eis**—because dessert should be as unforgettable as the view from our terrace overlooking the **Innsbrucker Alpen**.

Come for the food, stay for the atmosphere—**Joe’s Pizzeria in Tirol** is where Italian passion meets Alpine charm. **Benvenuti!** 🍕⛰️
